rationale: C13 is an unmistakable concrete drafting template for the child. The two letters follow virtually the same paragraph sequence and reproduce extensive language verbatim, with the later letter chiefly adapting the requester, request date, number of reports, and countries involved. Both identify ICA evaluation reports as internal advisory communications, invoke separation of powers and candid deliberation, certify nondisclosure under the same statutory provision, and promise disclosure of the underlying facts. C03 supplies closely related earlier executive-privilege language and machinery, while C12 parallels the withholding of confidential advisory reports but is less textually and structurally specific than C13.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As I have stated on other occasions, it is the established policy of the Executive Branch to provide the Congress and the public with the fullest possible information consistent with the national interest.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As I have stated on other occasions, it is the established policy of the Executive Branch to provide the Congress and the public with the fullest possible information consistent with the national interest.
shared_material.explanation: Exact shared opening formulation in C13.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is essential to effective administration that employees of the Executive Branch be in a position to be fully candid in advising with each other on official matters, and that the broadest range of individual opinions and advice be available in the formulation of decisions and policy.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is essential to effective administration that employees of the Executive Branch be in a position to be fully candid in advising with each other on official matters, and that the broadest range of individual opinions and advice be available in the formulation of decisions and policy.
shared_material.explanation: C13 reproduces the distinctive deliberative-confidentiality justification verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The ICA evaluation reports you have requested are internal Executive Branch communications comprising opinion and advice on official matters. They are of a class of reports prepared by small teams of senior officers on the basis of extensive study in the field and in Washington.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The ICA evaluation report which you have requested ... is an internal Executive Branch communication comprising opinion and advice on official matters. It is one of a class of reports prepared by small teams of senior officers on the basis of extensive study in the field and in Washington.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C13's singular Viet-Nam report description to plural reports concerning Iran and Thailand.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Since the disclosure of the reports requested by you would not be compatible with the national interest, I have forbidden that they be furnished pursuant to your request, and hereby so certify in accordance with section 111(d) of the Mutual Security Appropriation Act, 1960.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Since the disclosure of the report requested by you would not be compatible with the national interest, I have forbidden that it be furnished pursuant to such request and hereby so certify in accordance with Section I i i (d) of the Mutual Security Appropriation Act, 1960.
shared_material.explanation: The operative withholding and statutory-certification provision is materially identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Although I have forbidden the furnishing of the Evaluation Reports requested by you, I wish to make it clear that this has not been done for the purpose of preventing the disclosure of any facts shown by the reports. Such facts will be made available to you as promptly as possible.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Although I have forbidden the furnishing of the evaluation report requested by you, I wish to make it clear that this has not been done for the purpose of preventing the disclosure of any facts shown by the report. Such facts will be made available to you as promptly as possible.
shared_material.explanation: The closing qualification and promise are copied almost word for word, again changed principally from singular to plural.
